svg.title: Minemu system image format version 1
svg.desc: A diagram of the linear system ROM image, its header and record layouts, payload offsets, and the bootloader-created boot information record.
svg.text: Version 1 wire layout in System ROM | all integers are little-endian | offsets are relative to byte 0 of the image
Canonical packer order; K = kernel segments, M = modules, S_i = segments in module i
raw UTF-8 bytes | lengths stored separately | no NUL
data_offset in each KernelSegment points here
data_offset in each ModuleSegment points here
BSS is not stored: memory_size may exceed file_size
Offsets connect this record to its
name, segment table, and entry PC.
when it loads the user module.
BootInfo is not stored as another image section: the Boot ROM synthesizes its 64-byte record in RAM from the validated header.
Pointer fields use image-relative byte offsets. Tables and referenced ranges must lie entirely within image_size and must not overlap.
A zero-length segment payload stores no bytes; its data_offset may be 0. Reserved bytes must be zero.
